title: 第11章 先败一场第12章 一胜一负
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
真如寺这边，方丈真恒率领几位首座和近百名核心弟子，在演武场东侧列阵。
真寂虽不能出手，仍端坐在真恒身侧，面色如常，看不出任何异样。
尘悟寺那边，智圆方丈带着明心、寂明、寂空三位长老和十几名弟子，在西侧列阵。
两阵之间，隔着百丈方圆的演武场。
晨风吹过，将双方的僧袍吹得猎猎作响。
智圆看着对面的真如寺众人，嘴角浮起一丝笑意。
真如寺要脸，没排除“境”字辈高僧，出场阵容果然在他意料之中。
他的目光在真玄、真武、真悟三人身上扫过，心中已经在盘算着胜局之后的场景。
三局两胜。
寂明对真悟，胜算八成。寂空对真武，胜算七成。明心对真玄，胜算九成。
怎么算，尘悟寺都赢定了。
真恒站起身，走到演武场中央。
智圆也站起身，走到他对面。
两人相对而立，四目交汇。
“智圆方丈，”真恒的声音沉稳而洪亮，“比试之前，贫僧有一言相告。”
“方丈请说。”
“同是佛门一脉，切磋较技，点到为止。切莫伤了和气。”
智圆点了点头：“善哉善哉。贫僧也是这个意思。”
两人同时后退三步，各自回到阵中。

真恒坐下，看了真悟一眼。
真悟深吸一口气，站起身，大步朝演武场中央走去。
他的步伐很稳，每一步都踏得极实，黝黑的面庞上满是凝重之色。
走到演武场中央，他停下脚步，转过身，面朝尘悟寺的方向，双手合十。
“真如寺护持堂首座真悟，请尘悟寺高僧赐教。”
话音刚落，尘悟寺阵中站起一个身材矮胖的僧人。
正是寂明。
他大步流星地走进演武场，每一步踏出，地面都微微震动，仿佛一头巨象在行走。
走到真悟对面三丈处，寂明停下脚步，双手合十。
“尘悟寺罗汉堂首座寂明，请。”
两人的目光在空中交汇，仿佛有火花迸射。
真悟打量着面前的对手。
寂明矮胖敦实，圆脸上始终挂着一丝笑意，看起来像个弥勒佛。
但那双精光内敛的眼睛却出卖了他。
这是一个高手，一个真正的高手。
真悟深吸一口气，摆出了《金刚镇岳拳》的起手式。

At Zhenru Temple, Abbot Zhenheng led several chief disciples and nearly a hundred core disciples to form an array on the east side of the martial arts field.
Although Zhen Ji could not take action, he still sat beside Zhen Heng, his expression was as usual, and there was nothing unusual about him.
Over at Chenwu Temple, Abbot Zhiyuan led three elders, Mingxin, Jingming, and Jingkong, and a dozen disciples to form an array on the west side.
Between the two formations, there is a martial arts field with a radius of one hundred feet.
The morning breeze blew by, making the monks' robes on both sides rustle.
Zhiyuan looked at the people in Zhenru Temple opposite, with a smile on his lips.
Zhenru Temple was so important that he did not rule out eminent monks of the "Jing" generation, and the lineup was indeed what he expected.
His eyes swept over Zhenxuan, Zhenwu, and Zhenwu, and he was already thinking about the scene after the victory.
Best of three.
Ji Ming has an 80% chance of winning against true enlightenment. Jikong has a 70% chance of winning against Zhenwu. The clear mind versus the true mystery has a 90% chance of winning.
No matter how you calculate it, Chenwu Temple will definitely win.
Zhenheng stood up and walked to the center of the martial arts field.
Zhiyuan also stood up and walked to the opposite side of him.
The two stood opposite each other, their eyes meeting.
"Abbot Zhiyuan," Zhen Heng's voice was steady and loud, "Before the competition, the poor monk had something to say to me."
"Abbott, please speak."
"We are both from the same lineage of Buddhism. Let's compare and compete with each other until the point is reached. Don't hurt your harmony."
Zhiyuan nodded: "That's good. That's what the poor monk means."
The two of them took three steps back at the same time and returned to the formation.
Zhen Heng sat down and glanced at Zhen Wu.
Zhenwu took a deep breath, stood up, and strode towards the center of the martial arts field.
His steps were steady, each step was very solid, and his dark face was full of solemnity.
When he reached the center of the martial arts arena, he stopped, turned around, faced the direction of Chenwu Temple, and clasped his hands together.
"Zhenwu, the leader of the guardian hall of Zhenru Temple, please ask the eminent monk of Chenwu Temple for advice."
As soon as he finished speaking, a short and fat monk stood up in the formation of Chenwu Temple.
It is Jingming.
He strode into the martial arts arena, and with every step he took, the ground shook slightly, as if a giant elephant was walking.
Walking three feet across from Zhenwu, Jiming stopped and clasped his hands together.
"The first seat of Luohan Hall in Chenwu Temple is Jingming, please."
Their eyes met in the air, as if sparks were flying.
Zhenwu looked at the opponent in front of him.
Ji Ming is short, fat and stocky, with a smile on his round face. He looks like a Maitreya Buddha.
But those bright and restrained eyes gave him away.
This is a master, a real master.
Zhenwu took a deep breath and assumed the starting position of "King Kong Zhenyue Fist".
